This '''Trainer''' was a [[character of the day]] that appeared in ''[[HZ016|Quaxly, We Can Do It]]''. He was a mercenary paid by [[Spinel]] to delay [[Friede]] while the latter looked for [[Liko]]'s pendant. During the search, Friede boarded a ship where he believed Spinel was, only to be challenged by this Trainer, who was there instead. After Friede defeated him, the Trainer admitted he had no information to provide for the search.
